# spec: # The providers' PUBLIC machine-readable specifications the LLM-plane conformance gate validates
# busbar's wire output against. vendor.sh fetches each URL with curl, digests it, and REFUSES
# (exit 3, download deleted) if the digest is not byte-for-byte what this file pins — the same
# rule testing/shadow-oracle/golden-digests.tsv applies to the 1.5.5 reference binary.
# format
#   raw             sha256 of the bytes as served (GitHub raw at a pinned commit: immutable)
#   json-canonical  sha256 of the JSON re-serialized with sorted keys and no whitespace. Google
#                   serves the discovery document with a per-request key order (verified: two
#                   fetches, identical content, different bytes), so the raw bytes cannot be pinned.
# Pinned 2026-09-04. To re-pin after a provider publishes a new revision: run
#   testing/llm-conformance/vendor.sh --repin <spec>
# which prints the new row; paste it here and review what changed in the report before trusting it.
# openai      github.com/openai/openai-openapi, branch main @ 91cc0564f0e7ea0c53890061f1847162cf93cea7
#             covers /chat/completions (CreateChatCompletionRequest/Response/StreamResponse) and
#             /responses (CreateResponse, Response, ResponseStreamEvent) — one file, two dialects.
# anthropic   the OpenAPI document Anthropic publishes through Stainless; its URL is the one the
#             official SDK pins in anthropic-sdk-python/.stats.yml (openapi_spec_url) and is
#             content-addressed (the hash is in the file name). Covers /v1/messages: CreateMessageParams,
#             Message, MessageStreamEvent, ErrorResponse.
# gemini      the generativelanguage v1beta discovery document (revision 20260904 when pinned).
# bedrock     botocore's service model for bedrock-runtime (Converse, ConverseStream and the
#             ConverseStreamOutput event union), github.com/boto/botocore, develop @ e5c8122617a2c5c7e40bd364a835d5e38fd6e038
# cohere      github.com/cohere-ai/cohere-developer-experience, main @ b5d0e3bc0b64e5d9ad3c05b5c364641822593c94
#             (/v2/chat: request, ChatResponseV2, StreamedChatResponseV2, per-status error bodies)
openai
anthropic
gemini
